prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the edit target. Make one specific correction: TRANSLATE THE LARGE PROTECTIVE FIELD UP AND RIGHT so that the ENTIRE black titanium X is inside it.
The previous protruding upper-right tip was wrong. ALL FOUR terminals — top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right — must be fully inside the pale mint protected region. No part of the X may cross, touch, or protrude through the luminous rim. Leave a clearly visible gap of pale mint between the top-right tip and the curved rim above/right of it, about 5–7% of the rounded-square tile width.

Keep the protective field's CURRENT LARGE RADIUS. Do not shrink the circle or shrink/move the X. Shift the circle center rightward by roughly 7–9% of the tile width and upward by roughly 4–6% of the tile height. As a geometry guide relative to the app tile, a circle center around 40% width / 60% height with radius about 57% of the tile width contains all four X terminals with margin. The curved luminous boundary is now visibly ABOVE and to the RIGHT of the upper-right X terminal, separated by empty pale mint space.
The large protected field should still extend beyond the left and bottom edges of the tile, naturally clipped by the rounded-square boundary. Preserve a visible cooler sage-gray outer region near the upper-right peripheral portion of the tile.

Keep exactly the same original X geometry, scale, position, black titanium face and thin metallic bevels. Preserve the light mint protected interior #EAF6EF, cooler sage-gray exterior #C4D5CE, glass-like curved refraction boundary, and restrained partial pearl-mint highlight. Same tile shape, rounded corners, white surrounding canvas and framing.
Change only the placement of the protective field and its linked color boundary/highlight. No new objects, no text, no complete outlined ring, no thick glow. The final visual MUST show every part of X sheltered inside the large pale mint region with breathing room.
user_direction: X 不应伸出圈外，移动保护圈。
note: 保持大保护圈，向右上移动；X 四个端点全部位于浅绿圈内，与光弧保留空隙。此要求替代此前仅三个端点在圈内的解释。
rejection_reason: 用户取消保护圈，恢复浅绿纯色底与黑钛 X。
